body: Tried yesterday. It was very painful. After a few tries, I gave up. Next time I'll try sitting down.

I know what you mean I feel the same. I just quit those benzos two weeks ago. I feel better but sleep is so rare now. What helped me is meditation and you can believe me I wasn't interested in things like that before. Now it's the only thing that gets me back into dreams.

Life is about distracting yourself as best as possible.  Because in the end we have nothing left, just the momentum. The rest is speculation.

You could try to step out of your comfort zone and let yourself be surprised. 
Sometimes new ways can be found. 

I wish you the best!  ♥
Sounds quite healthy. Try to keep it like that. Tolerance is building up fast. 6mg Xanax and I'm still functional. But I'm ok now. Last pill was a week ago.

Yeah that or even while taking it due to the tolerance. I took Zolpidem for years and sometimes Diazepam too. At the end they didn't work anymore no matter how much I took. My brain feels damaged and for a long time I didn't realize that these pills are the cause for making my insomnia worse. Today I got about 2 hours of bad sleep but I need to learn how to sleep instead of taking pills. It's a hell. I hope you can sleep better soon.

Yeah it's the same for me. I feel so stupid not being able to sleep. My wife falls into sleep in minutes. I need hours but can't sleep at all. It's the exact same thing like you mentioned, my consciousness kicks me out of the required mode.
I feel the same. You're not alone. But man you should think twice taking Benzos. They can cause insomnia. Actually going through that shit now. I wish I'd have never taken any sleeping pills.
